title: Tuna Noodles
description: Classic Italian-style tuna and tomato spaghetti — simple, high-protein and ready in 20 minutes.

ingredients.text: 5g oil, salt, black pepper, chili flakes

steps: Cook pasta per packet; reserve 50g pasta water; drain.
Halve tomatoes. Peel and mince garlic.
Fry garlic in oil 20 sec; add tomatoes and water; close lid; simmer 6 min until tomatoes break.
Add tuna; cook 30 sec; season with salt, pepper and chili flakes.
Add cooked pasta + reserved pasta water; toss 30 sec. Done.
notes: Originally made with shirataki noodles (10 kcal/100g). Swapped for 80g dry wheat noodles (~280 kcal). Macros adjusted accordingly. Top with parsley or basil.
